Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.2

Kargo

The serious alternative: a promotion control plane with its own UI.

WHAT IT IS

An Akuity project modelling promotion as Warehouses (sources), Freight (versioned bundles) and Stages, with promotion steps and verification between them.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Built for complex multi-stage pipelines and fleet-to-target mapping, with a UI release managers can live in. ⚠️ Its adoption figure in our notes is vendor-reported.

WHERE WE STAND

Spike it second. It wins if what we want is a release-management UI across many targets rather than PRs as the record.

Akuity; ArgoCon fleet demo, KubeCon NA 2026

DECIDE

Kargo: The serious alternative: a promotion control plane with its own UI. Where we stand: Spike it second. It wins if what we want is a release-management UI across many targets rather than PRs as the record. Akuity maintains both Argo CD and Kargo, so read their comparisons accordingly. That's why we want our own spike.
